description: Presidential Secretariat - Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979
reasoning: This gazette content is a presidential order made under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979, declaring specific services (electricity supply, petroleum distribution, and hospital/patient care services) to be essential public services. This constitutes a regulatory/legal action as it invokes statutory powers to modify the legal status of these services and create compliance requirements under the Act. It fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
